== Summary ==

:{{pov|[[Matrim Cauthon]]}}
Mat wakes up outside on the grass after the previous night’s events. He is interrupted by voices talking about the escaped [[Gray Man]]. He's quite embarrassed by his and [[Fortuona Athaem Devi Paendrag|Tuon]]'s nakedness even though [[Musenge]] is bowing his head towards the ground. A [[Deathwatch Guard]] approaches and tells them that another suspected assassin has been captured. Tuon bids him to bring the assassin forward as she gets dressed. The assassin is actually [[Rand al'Thor|Rand]]. Tuon shouts for her ''[[damane]]'' to be brought quickly. Rand remains nonchalant. Mat, thinking Rand has gone mad, jumps between addressing Tuon and Rand, appealing to him to remain calm, despite no obvious signs of hostility. Rand thanks Mat for bringing him to her and Tuon demands to know if Mat exploited Tuon's affection to bring Rand in. Mat is suddenly caught up in air. Rand reveals that he is shielded and could not have done it, and Mat realizes that Tuon has stolen his [[Silver foxhead medallion|medallion]]. Mat is deposited next to Rand. While Tuon signs with Selucia, Mat and Rand catch each other up on their exploits, each trying to one-up the other. 

Tuon believes Rand has surrendered himself to the [[Seanchan]], claiming that he and his ancestors forgot their oaths and thus making the Seanchan the sole heirs of [[Artur Hawkwing]]. In turn, Rand asks what she would have done if they had arrived at the shores only to find the armies of [[Artur Paendrag Tanreall|Artur Hawkwing]] still ruling. Tuon insists it is still her right to rule the lands as she is a descendant of Hawkwing himself. Rand proves her logic is wrong as he is [[Lews Therin Telamon]] reborn, so his rule supersedes her own. At this, the grass begins to grow more green around Rand although the damane claim he is still shielded. Mat notices that Rand is singing very softly, and as he does so the green spreads and sprouts more trees and growth.

He then kneels before Tuon, one hand extended to her and again asks Tuon to ally with him and fight in the [[Tarmon Gai'don|Last Battle]]. Mat, after finding he is no longer bound, runs to Tuon and convinces her to use Rand to their advantage. Mat says she can trust Rand, but if not, she can trust him. Mat suggests she have him secure their borders in [[Altara]]. Rand grants her peace for 100 years and a claim on [[Tarabon]] and half of [[Almoth Plain]], but he refuses them the right to capture more damane and demands that Tuon release all the damane the Seanchan have captured. After negotiating, Rand compromises and allows her to keep those already collared but she will not be allowed to take anymore during or after the Last Battle from those that have signed the [[Dragon's Peace]]. The Empress agrees to the conditions and will sign the Dragon's Peace, allowing Rand to go in freedom.

With the agreement made, everyone retreats to go prepare for war. Before he leaves, Mat tells Rand that he saved [[Moiraine Damodred|Moiraine]], thus winning their boasting competition. As Mat turns and leaves, he hears the laughter of the Dragon Reborn.
